# BSpot AI

> Cross-border investment intelligence for South Asian and African investors — real costs, real laws, real-time markets, and AI-powered roadmaps for setting up businesses in UAE, UK, Canada, Singapore, KSA, Germany, and more.

BSpot AI helps founders and investors compare countries, model setup costs, watch live markets, and get tailored relocation/business roadmaps.
